name: Daily County-Level Stratified Counts
description: Sparse, daily county-level dataset of Medicare hospitalizations and mortality, including only dates with recorded events. The data is stratified by demographics and eligibility factors such as age, sex, race, and dual enrollment status.

content.date: Date32[day]: Specific date of death count
content.age_grp: String: Age group category of deceased beneficiaries
content.race_rti: String: RTI race classification of the beneficiary
content.dual: Int32: Dual eligibility status (1 = dual-eligible, 0 = not eligible)
content.buyin: Int32: State buy-in status (1 = yes, 0 = no)
content.n_dead: Int64: Number of deaths for the given subgroup and date
content.n_hosp: Int64: Number of hospitalizations for the given subgroup and date
